name: Saianand Commercial Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Saianand Commercial Ltd is in the business of wholesale trading[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SCL (formerly Oregon Commercials Ltd) is involved in Other wholesale, which
 includes specialized wholesale activities 
not classified under any specific category, 
as well as wholesale trading in a variety 
of goods without any particular specialization

pros: Stock is trading at 0.18 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.03% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.30 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 1,871 days to 3,668 days
